scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler deploy --env staging --config wrangler.ingest.jsonc && wrangler deploy --env staging --config wrangler.mcp.jsonc
